# Forwarding to plain http leaks the request path; only lines without a
# forward are clean.
server {
    # ruleid: insecure-redirect
    rewrite ^/old http://example.com/new redirect;
    # ruleid: insecure-redirect
    rewrite ^/legacy http://example.com/legacy redirect;
    # ok: insecure-redirect
    return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    # ok: insecure-redirect
    listen 80;
}
